description: AI creative studio with ComfyUI - generate images, video, audio, 3D
fullDescription:
ComfyUI is the most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI with a launcher for model and workflow management.

Features:
- Node-based workflow editor
- Launcher with model manager
- Supports SD, SDXL, SD3, Flux, video models
- ControlNet, LoRA support
- GPU accelerated
